snippet.title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Developer Interview - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
An exclusive interview with the dev team behind Anno 117: Pax Romana, an upcoming city-building real-time strategy game where it's up to you to shape the future of the Roman Empire in 117 AD. The latest entry in the award-winning Anno series, the game will launch on November 13th for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #anno117paxromana 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
